_meta.zeroRule: A 0 value is only status:'verified-zero' when either (a) at least two independent sources agree on 0/trace, or (b) a named rule (rule:plant-cholesterol, rule:pure-water) applies. A single source's explicit 0.00 reading is recorded as status:'researched', value 0, confidence:'low', method:'single-source' - NOT 'verified-zero' - per design.md Decision 5's distinction. An omitted/blank column in a source is never recorded as 0 at all.
